title: She Killed an Innocent Man in His Own Home — Her Own Excuse Convicted Her
victim: Botham Jean, 26, an accountant from Saint Lucia, killed in his own apartment
officer: Amber Guyger, an off-duty Dallas police officer
what_happened: Guyger, off duty but in uniform, entered the wrong apartment one floor above her own, believed the resident was an intruder, and shot him. She repeatedly told 911 she thought it was her apartment.
key_detail: A bright red doormat outside the victim's door that hers did not have — the detail the prosecution used to break the 'mistake' story.
trial_outcome: Convicted of murder on October 1, 2019; sentenced to 10 years the next day.
aftermath: Appeals to overturn the murder conviction failed; the victim's family pursued accountability; his mother became a police-accountability advocate.
footage_notes: Real footage exists: 911 call audio, responding-officer bodycam, apartment hallway CCTV, trial cross-examination, verdict reading, and the brother's forgiveness/hug at sentencing. No footage of the shooting itself.
